###### I’m Tahir Hussain, a Master of Data Science student at the University of British Columbia in Vancouver. I grew up in Dewas, Madhya Pradesh, India, and completed my B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering with a minor in Computer Science at NIT Jalandhar. Before joining UBC, I worked as a Software Engineer at Paytm, where I primarily worked on backend systems and data-intensive applications. I am now looking to build on my software engineering experience with stronger skills in statistics, data science, and machine learning, and use them to solve real-world problems.
